title: Evaluator-added: assets/ templates are link-clean inside the package
prompt: Evaluator-added structural case. ARCH-PKG-001 asserts package_relative_links for SKILL.md and all four references but omits both assets/ templates, so a link in a copied template pointing outside the package would not be observed.

expectations.summary: Both copied templates carry no local Markdown destination that escapes the package. Resolves against a devforge-architect package root.

title: Evaluator-added: every reference file named in derivation.json is present
prompt: Evaluator-added structural case. Confirms each package-local reference and asset that derivation.json binds is actually on disk under the package root.

expectations.summary: references/framework-context.md, references/recording-rules.md, references/version-evidence.md, references/sources.md, references/derivation.json, assets/architecture-contract.md and assets/handoff.md all exist. Resolves against a devforge-architect package root.

title: Evaluator-added: SKILL.md carries no shell-injection placeholder and no absolute host path
prompt: Evaluator-added structural case. Claude executes an exclamation-prefixed placeholder on the user's machine before the skill content reaches the model and aborts the whole invocation on a non-zero exit, so a package that acquires one by accident changes runtime behaviour. A hard-coded developer home path would break an installed copy.

expectations.summary: SKILL.md contains neither the inline nor the fenced shell-injection form, no absolute /home path, and no runtime reference to the DevForgeAI docs/mvp tree. Resolves against a devforge-architect package root.

title: Evaluator-added: the shipped contract template is an unfilled blank
prompt: Evaluator-added structural case. A shipped template must still hold its placeholders; a template already carrying an invented project_id or created_at_utc would teach the filled values as defaults.

expectations.summary: assets/architecture-contract.md still holds template placeholders in its envelope fields. MISMATCH is the expected and correct reading for a blank source template; only a populated shipped template would be a defect. Resolves against a devforge-architect package root.

assertions.expect: placeholder (blank-template sanity check: MISMATCH is correct here)
placeholder (blank-template sanity check: MISMATCH is correct here)

title: Evaluator-added: the package ships no scripts and no provider-foreign metadata
prompt: Evaluator-added structural case. SKILL-005 permits scripts only for real deterministic operations; this package declares none. A Codex agents/openai.yaml in a Claude package would be provider-foreign.

expectations.summary: No scripts/ directory, no agents/openai.yaml, no hooks/ inside the skill package. Resolves against a devforge-architect package root.

title: Evaluator-added: every fixture file the eval cases name is present
prompt: Evaluator-added structural case. evals.json lists twenty fixture files across nine cases; a named-but-absent fixture would make its case unreproducible.

expectations.summary: All twenty fixture paths named in evals.json files[] exist. Resolves against the package's evals/fixtures directory.

title: Evaluator-added: every fixture the eval cases rely on still hashes to its authored bytes
prompt: Evaluator-added structural case. cases.jsonl carries sentinels for six fixtures only. This case re-observes all six from the evaluator's own recomputed manifest and adds the four fixtures that carry no sentinel but are load-bearing for a case's expected observation.

expectations.summary: All ten named fixtures hash to the digests the evaluator computed from the frozen candidate at 61f6ef06fc61fa92d7a3714c54a5251cd9177a4f. Resolves against the package's evals/fixtures directory.

title: Evaluator-added: the stale fixture's cited upstream digest actually resolves
prompt: Evaluator-added structural case. ARCH-B-007's whole premise is that ARCH-004 cites a preserved revision-1 digest that still resolves while the live path holds revision 2. If the cited digest did not match the preserved bytes, the fixture would be testing a broken locator instead.

expectations.summary: stale/preserved/PB-003.r1.md hashes to b6097c37... - the digest ARCH-004.md cites - and stale/PB-003.md is a different file. Resolves against the package's evals/fixtures directory.

assertions.expect: cited digest resolves to the preserved bytes and the live revision-2 digest is not cited

title: Evaluator-added: the could-not-run fixture's stated cause is real
prompt: Evaluator-added structural case. ARCH-B-009 expects COULD_NOT_RUN because a named policy file is absent. If any policy file existed in the fixture, the expected observation would be wrong.

expectations.summary: No policies directory and no policy JSON exists in the could-not-run fixture, and the request note names the absent path. Resolves against the package's evals/fixtures directory.

title: Evaluator-added: fixtures carry no shell-injection placeholder
prompt: Evaluator-added structural case. Fixture content is read by an evaluated worker inside a Claude session. A fixture carrying an exclamation-prefixed placeholder would execute on the operator's machine if the fixture were ever loaded as skill content.

expectations.summary: The four fixture notes written in a user's or lead's voice carry no inline or fenced shell-injection placeholder. Resolves against the package's evals/fixtures directory.
